data.name: Eldegarda
data.gender_notes: Eldegarda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German words 'elda' (elf) and 'gero' (spear). This name was often given to girls in the Middle Ages, suggesting strength and otherworldly protection. The name Eldegarda carries the meaning “Elf spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eldegarda usually hope their child will grow to embody elf spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine protection granted to those who carry the name Eldegarda.
data.etymology: Eldegarda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elf spear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eldegarda total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אלדגארדה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלדר - עם אלוהים, גארדה - שומרת, מגנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלדגארדה מורכבת משתי מילים: אלדר, שמקורה במילה העברית 'אל' ו'דר', שמשמעותה עם אלוהים, וגארדה, שמשמעותה שומרת או מגנה. השם אלדגארדה משלב את הרעיון של להיות עם אלוהים ושמירה על האמונה.

in_greek.name: Ελδεγάρδα
in_greek.meaning: Ελ - αρχαία ελληνική λέξη για το אלוהים, δε - δουλεύω, γάρ - προστατεύω
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελδεγάρδα προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική γλώσσα και συντίθεται από το Ελ, που σχετίζεται με το אלוהים, και το γάρ, που σημαίνει προστατεύω ή υπηρετώ. Ονομάζεται έτσι επειδή συμβολίζει την προστασία και την υπηρεσία στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Eldegarda
in_latin.meaning: Elder - old, wise; garda - guard, protect
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Eldegarda is derived from Old High German words 'eld' meaning old or wise and 'garda' meaning guard or protect. It signifies one who is wise and protective, embodying the qualities of spiritual guidance and safeguarding.

in_english.name: Eldegarda
in_english.meaning: Combination of 'Elder' and 'Guard', signifying wise protector
in_english.long_meaning: Eldegarda is a Christian name derived from Old High German, combining 'eld' (old, wise) and 'garda' (guard). It symbolizes a wise protector or guardian of faith, reflecting spiritual maturity and protective qualities valued in Christian tradition.
